opportunities.name: Fury entry barrage
opportunities.objective: Reach finite Fury quickly after unburrowing and reserve it for E.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive grants 25 Fury per attack or ability; unburrowed Q empowers three attacks with 35% speed. E calculations list an AD term and 1.2 empowered multiplier despite unresolved cross-reference rendering. BotRK and a finite Hullbreaker fifth-hit state support actual attacks, while Stridebreaker maintains contact; primary R resets W.
opportunities.requiredState: Enter with stated Fury and log each ability/attack before choosing E.
opportunities.failure: Burrowing spends Fury on healing or crowd control prevents the Q sequence.
opportunities.test: Record Fury after every action and E damage type at submax versus max Fury; compare R's W reset.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An unresolved E tooltip cross-reference is not absent data: the calculation exists, but its raw AD flag still needs verification. Titanic cannot be combined with Stridebreaker; choose one Cleave item.

opportunities.name: Burrow recovery cycle
opportunities.objective: Trade a burst window for a safe three-second burrow heal and reentry.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive consumes Fury over three seconds to restore a health-based amount. Visage and health purchases test the recovery value; Cleaver's physical ramp benefits Q attacks before retreat. Tunnel entrances give a planned exit, subject to per-tunnel reuse limits.
opportunities.requiredState: Fury earned in combat, protected tunnel exit and sufficient time to finish recovery.
opportunities.failure: Pursuit denies healing time or insufficient bonus health leaves Warmog inactive.
opportunities.test: Measure actual burrow recovery at matched Fury/health with and without Visage, and time to reentry.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Tunnels do not remove their own reuse cooldowns or allow attacks while burrowed.

ruledOut.reason: A helper has different R base damage from the primary; use the primary and verify instead of adding them.

unknowns: Burrowed Q/W/E cross-reference rendering and passive healing base remain unresolved. E calculations and tunnel raw values exist, but raw AD semantics and helper/primary conflicts require checks; old R helper totals are not authoritative.

E calculations list an AD term and 1.2 empowered multiplier despite unresolved cross-reference rendering. BotRK and a finite Hullbreaker fifth-hit state support actual attacks, while Stridebreaker maintains contact; primary R resets W.
testPlan: Required state: Enter with stated Fury and log each ability/attack before choosing E.
Record Fury after every action and E damage type at submax versus max Fury; compare R's W reset.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Burrowing spends Fury on healing or crowd control prevents the Q sequence.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: An unresolved E tooltip cross-reference is not absent data: the calculation exists, but its raw AD flag still needs verification. Titanic cannot be combined with Stridebreaker; choose one Cleave item.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Hullbreaker, Stridebreaker, Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing @spell.RekSaiE:BaseDamageCalculation@ physical damage. At max Fury, the bite deals @spell.RekSaiE:EmpoweredDamageCalculation@ true damage instead.

Rek'Sai generates [25] Fury when she Attacks and [25] Fury from Abilities.

While Burrowed, she consumes her Fury to restore up to [(UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw)) × Stat(12)] Health over [3] seconds, increasing with level.

Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within [3] seconds gain [35]% Attack Speed and deal an additional [(0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5) × AD] physical damage to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.

Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last [5] seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [15 / 20 / 25]% max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of {{Spell_RekSaiW_Name}}.

Unburrowed: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains [5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25] Move Speed, [65]% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.
